values.meaning: duration of the attack speed buff

mechanics.claim: Recasting Tough It Out while already active refreshes the attack speed value rather than stacking it.
mechanics.quote: ''Tough It Out's'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} value is updated when it is cast, even if it was already active.

mechanics.claim: Casting Tough It Out resets Olaf's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Tough It Out {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Olaf's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: The missing-health portion of the shield is capped once Olaf is at or below 30% missing health (i.e. at or above 70% missing health), equal to 12.5% of maximum health.
mechanics.quote: At {{as|70% '''missing''' health}}, the health ratio portion of the shield is capped at the equivalent of {{as|{{fd|12.5}}% '''maximum''' health}}.
